Subject: Request: extra evaluation credits for bakeoff extension

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Catalyst is excited and wants to run a fuller, head-to-head bench across our clinical routing and triage flows. Our original scope was light; after kicking off the tests we realized we need an extra 6 live days and a larger token budget to stress the KV cache and latency tail behaviors (those are the failure modes we want to catch).

Can Redwood provide a one-time evaluation accelerator: 150k tokens (or equivalent $ credit) and a 14-day trial extension? We understand this is promotional, so we can sign a mutual action plan (attached: Catalyst-MAP-v2.pdf) that limits the credit to the bakeoff and commits to a post-bakeoff evaluation call.

Timeline is tight — we’d like to start the expanded run on Friday (9/3). Please let me know what you can commit to and any approvals you need from your side.

Appreciate it,
Jared
Director of Engineering
Catalyst Health

Attachments: Catalyst-MAP-v2.pdf (Mutual action plan, scope & KPIs)

- We'll need a signed MAP (your doc) and a short SO amendment to record the credit and retention terms.

Jared — if that’s acceptable, confirm and I’ll route the SO. If you strongly need the full 150k, we may be able to top up after the initial results depending on the findings (and a quick exec sign-off).
